highlights.title: A new look
highlights.detail: A sidebar holds the four views and collapses to icons. On a phone it opens from the menu button. Filters, the period, dialogs and tables use one consistent set of controls in light and dark.

highlights.title: An iPhone app
highlights.detail: Spending is a native iPhone app with a summary of each month, trends, every transaction and search. It signs in with the same Google account and keeps the last data for use offline.
